# Vishnu Vardhan Burri

Canonical site: https://www.vishnuvardhanburri.in/

Vishnu Vardhan Burri is a backend systems and AI infrastructure engineer focused on production-critical APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, observability, AI guardrails, data integrity, and platform reliability for founder-led products and engineering teams.

## Xavira Tech Labs

Xavira Tech Labs is the engineering firm and product lab founded by Vishnu Vardhan Burri. Its product layer is Xavira Control Stack, which includes:

- Sovereign Engine: Enterprise communication operations, reputation intelligence, monitoring, and communication governance.
- Sovereign Shield: Private AI governance, compliance controls, auditability, security, and operational visibility.
- Xavira AI Assistant: Custom-trained AI assistants for operations, support, compliance, sales, knowledge management, and internal workflows.

Commercial options:

- Internal License: £40,000
- White Label: £160,000
- Maintenance: £3k/month

## How To Engage

For direct scheduling, use https://www.vishnuvardhanburri.in/book.

For context-first inquiries, use https://www.vishnuvardhanburri.in/contact.

Useful context to send:

- Product URL or short product summary
- Current stack and deployment setup
- Main backend, AI, automation, or production problem
- Timeline and urgency
- Budget range or licensing interest
- Any production logs, error codes, or screenshots
